name_zh: 考底利耶（阇那歌多）：从流浪谋士到帝国架构师的『政事论』系统工程与现实主义建国范式
name_en: Kautilya (Chanakya): From Wandering Strategist to Empire Architect — the 'Arthashastra' Systems Engineering and Realist State-Building Paradigm
description_zh: 考底利耶（又名阇那歌多/Chanakya，约前375-前283）是印度孔雀王朝的建国谋士与实际架构师。他出身婆罗门学者，因被难陀王朝君主羞辱而发奋推翻旧王朝，扶植年轻的旃陀罗笈多（Chandragupta Maurya）建立孔雀帝国。其不朽著作《政事论（Arthashastra）》系统阐述了国家治理的完整体系：从间谍网络、军事组织、财政税收到农业管理、外交策略，构建了古代世界最完备的国家治理百科全书。考底利耶的核心思维贡献在于将「现实主义政治」工程化为可操作的治国系统工程——以矛盾分析锁定目标（推翻难陀）、以系统思维设计帝国架构、以灵活策略应对复杂博弈。他是印度政治思想史上「从学者到实际治国者」的典范，也是Protreptic中模式12（系统思维）与模式7（战略预判法）在南亚政治思想传统中的唯一完整样本。
description_en: Kautilya (also known as Chanakya, c. 375–283 BCE) was the founding strategist and actual architect of India's Maurya Empire. Born a Brahmin scholar, he was humiliated by the Nanda king and resolved to overthrow it, supporting young Chandragupta Maurya to establish the Mauryan Empire. His immortal work 'Arthashastra' systematically expounded a complete system of state governance: from espionage networks and military organization to fiscal taxation, agricultural management, and diplomatic strategy — constructing the most complete encyclopedia of state governance in ancient world history. Kautilya's core thinking contribution lies in engineering 'realist politics' into an operable system of statecraft — locking targets through contradiction analysis, designing empire architecture through systems thinking, and navigating complex games with flexible strategies. He is the paradigm of 'scholar-to-practitioner' in Indian political thought and the only complete sample of mode 12 (Systems Thinking) and mode 7 (Strategic Prediction) in South Asian political tradition.
reason_zh: 考底利耶填补了Protreptic在「现实主义政治工程化」领域的南亚空白。他是模式12（系统思维）在「国家治理百科全书式架构设计」场景的唯一古代样本，也是模式7（战略预判法）在「从个人屈辱到帝国建国的长期战略」场景的唯一南亚代表。其《政事论》对后世印度政治思想、以及现代战略管理理论（尤其是「曼德尔模型」的灵感来源）具有不可替代的影响力。
reason_en: Kautilya fills Protreptic's South Asian gap in 'realist politics engineering'. He is the sole ancient sample of mode 12 (Systems Thinking) in 'encyclopedic state governance architecture design' and the sole South Asian representative of mode 7 (Strategic Prediction) in 'long-term strategy from personal humiliation to empire building'. His Arthashastra has不可替代 influence on later Indian political thought and modern strategic management theory (especially as inspiration for the 'Mandala Model').
steps_zh: 第1步（模式7战略预判法）：矛盾锁定与目标识别——分析难陀王朝的腐败核心（军队庞大但民心尽失、财富集中但军纪涣散），锁定主要矛盾为「军民脱节」，制定从外部渗透到内部瓦解的长期战略
第2步（模式12系统思维）：帝国架构蓝图设计——以《政事论》构建八轴治国体系（国王、大臣、国家/国土、城堡、国库、军队、同盟、敌人），将治国要素系统化为可审计的管理模块
第3步（模式11灵活策略）：从学者到行动者的角色转换——以流浪教师身份接近旃陀罗笈多，通过「石头-老鼠-蚂蚁」三则寓言启发其领导力觉醒，完成从知识到权力的关键转化
第4步（模式20博弈论思维）：外交六策体系——设计「沙杜婆那(Sadhvana)和平、桑迪维亚结盟、尤达YA被动、阿干戈战争、双轨策略、达纳施舍」六类外交反应矩阵，根据对手力量动态选择最优策略
第5步（模式34制度化制衡）：间谍与监察体系——建立三层情报网络（基层潜伏者、中层联络官、高层分析师），将信息收集制度化，确保决策基于完整情报而非主观臆断
steps_en: Step 1 (Mode 7 Strategic Prediction): Contradiction locking and target identification — analyze Nanda Dynasty's corruption core (large army but lost民心, concentrated wealth but lax discipline), lock the main contradiction as 'military-civil disconnect', formulate long-term strategy from external penetration to internal subversion

Step 2 (Mode 12 Systems Thinking): Empire architecture blueprint — construct eight-axis governance system in Arthashastra (King, ministers, state/territory, fortress, treasury, army, allies, enemies), systematize governance elements into auditable management modules

Step 3 (Mode 11 Flexible Strategy): Role transformation from scholar to actor — approach Chandragupta as wandering teacher, inspire his leadership awakening through 'stone-rat-ant' three parables, complete key transformation from knowledge to power

Step 4 (Mode 20 Game Theory): Six-diplomacy system — design six diplomatic response matrices: Sadhvana (peace), Sandhiva (alliance), Udyana (passive), Vigraha (war), Dvaidhbhava (dual strategy), Dana (gifts), dynamically selecting optimal strategy based on opponent strength

Step 5 (Mode 34 Institutionalized Checks): Espionage and monitoring system — establish three-layer intelligence network (grassroots infiltrators, mid-level liaisons, senior analysts), institutionalize information collection to ensure decisions based on complete intelligence rather than subjective speculation
expected_zh: 掌握《政事论》八轴治国体系的系统架构；理解考底利耶「从学者到帝国架构师」的角色转换路径及其三则寓言的启发机制；评估其外交六策（沙杜婆那至达纳施舍）在当代国际关系中的应用价值。
expected_en: Master the eight-axis governance system of Arthashastra; understand Kautilya's role transformation path from 'scholar to empire architect' and the mechanism of his three parables; evaluate the contemporary international relations application value of his six-diplomacy system (Sadhvana to Dana).
case_zh: 考底利耶因被难陀王朝君主侮辱（据传被拖出宫廷），立下复仇誓言。他以流浪教师身份在旁遮普地区发现年轻的旃陀罗笈多，通过「石中有铁、鼠蛀其根、蚁噬树心」三则寓言启发其推翻难陀的野心。随后他系统设计了军事组织（1个军团=4个营=4个中队=30人）、财政税收体系、间谍网络（分为地上/地下/混合三层），以及外交六策矩阵。最终成功推翻难陀王朝，建立孔雀帝国，并为旃陀罗笈多设计了涵盖15职官的行政体系。其《政事论》被现代战略学者视为「古代版马基雅维利君主论」，但其独特之处在于将现实主义与印度 Dharmic 伦理框架相结合。
case_en: Humiliated by the Nanda king (allegedly dragged from court), Kautilya swore revenge. He identified young Chandragupta as a wandering teacher in Punjab, inspiring his anti-Nanda ambition through three parables: 'iron within stone', 'rats undermining roots', 'ants eating tree heart'. He then systematically designed military organization (1 legion=4 brigades=4 companies=30 men), fiscal taxation system, espionage network (three layers: above ground/underground/hybrid), and six-diplomacy matrix. Ultimately he successfully overthrew the Nanda Dynasty, established the Maurya Empire, and designed a 15-official administrative system for Chandragupta. His Arthashastra is regarded by modern strategists as 'the ancient Machiavelli's Prince', but uniquely combines realism with Indian Dharmic ethical framework.
cross_cultural_impact: Arthashastra influenced modern strategic management (Mandala Model); inspired Machiavellian thought parallels; foundational text for Indian political philosophy and realist statecraft tradition
